 near the confluence of the Śoṇa and the Ganges, and identified by some
 with the modern Pātṇā. It is also known by the names of {#puzpapura#},
 {#kusumapura#}; see <ls>Mu. 2</ls>, <ls n="Mu.">3</ls>, and 4. 16, and <ls>R. 6. 24</ls> also; {#tadidaM divyaM#}
